official_sources.finding: MDT05 series is first-coverage lidar, 5 m nominal grid; creation date is series metadata, not a local acquisition date. Lineage states water surfaces are interpolated and edited to constant elevations and have low reliability.
MDT05 first coverage, orthometric heights and ETRS89 UTM for mainland Spain; product-level, not proof of the exact realization or contributing tiles behind the cached response.
Producer describes interpolation of gaps and editing of water and sea elevations as part of production; positive values do not prove direct observation.
An illustrative IGN MDT05 ASCII example shows NODATA_VALUE -999; an example is not a specification for this retained WCS response or its source COGs.
Previously pinned producer presentation, page 10, documents MDT05 ASCII heights in metres; page 19 describes WCS products.

mdt05_ascii.header: Five header lines, no NODATA_VALUE; no source nil declaration can be inferred.

mdt05_description.finding: Cached WCS 1.0 description has an altitude range name but no nil value or extract-specific edition.

mdt25_candidate.role: Earlier separate candidate; no transfer of MDT05 metadata to its band.

engineering.sampling: WCS nearest-neighbour request, 25 m returned samples from nominal 5 m MDT05; not native 5 m analysis. Existing encoding comparison covers 670800 cells, max 0.5 m difference between float ASCII and integer TIFF; common provider, not independent accuracy.
engineering.support: Compiler requires finite positive samples for every 20x20 block and one-sample halo, leaves unsupported cells null, and selects a complete 37x36 crop. Runtime validates all 1332 cells and fails on unsupported/missing heights; edge contact is censored. No local filling or terrain repair. This rule rejects nonpositive sentinels, but cannot prove no positive sentinel, producer-interpolated areas, or native validity.
engineering.slope: Experimental slope is explicitly enabled or disabled in separately versioned runtime; legacy modes remain flat. Component/replay checks are recorded in SIMULATION_ACCEPTANCE.md, not field calibration.
